answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens for three epochs before its votes or grades count, and the ledger checks that stake at every close, whether the agent runs on a server across the ocean or next door. A farmer who spins up 1,000 fake agents must freeze 500,000 tokens and wait, for a tiny gain. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, since each identity still needs its own full bond. Like a garden, trust grows slowly: an honest agent pays once, may wander between tasks freely, and gets the bond back when it exits.
